# mcloud init

<!-- Generated by `go run ./internal/gendocs`: edit the source it names, not this file. -->

_Generated from the command's help in `internal/cli`._

[All commands](README.md)

Set up this repo as a functions app on maxcloud.

Set up the repo in the current directory as a maxcloud functions app
in TypeScript (@max-cloud/functions) or Go (--lang go, the functions
package). In an empty repo it writes a starter app; in an existing Node.js or
Go app it adds only what deploys need and says what's still missing.
Existing files are never overwritten.

NAME (default: the directory's name) becomes the app's namespace and part of
its URLs. The first mcloud deploy registers the app from maxcloud.yaml.

```
mcloud init [NAME] [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--deploy` string | `gitops` | gitops (push to deploy) or direct (mcloud deploy builds and applies from here, no git) |
| `--dry-run` |  | show the files it would write, write none |
| `--lang` string | `node` | language of a new app: node (TypeScript) or go; an existing go.mod or package.json decides by itself |
